text:
maya: quick heads up — prod SAST/DAST evidence gap after a KMS rotate smoke failed; blocked release for payments-v2. logs show KMS: PERMISSION_DENIED on cryptoKeyVersions.get. link: https://logs.internal/tx/64432-kms-fail

owen: restarting scanner-ingest cleared the backlog but that's a manual band-aid. we should add automated guards: pre-rotation scanner smoke, correlation-id propagation, and a token-broker for short-lived decrypt grants.

lia: +1. also we need a placeholder-evidence pattern: when decrypt fails upload a tiny JSON with fields {scan_run, repo, error_code, provisional:true} to the evidence-store and mark the finding provisional in the vuln tracker.

maya: minimal GH Actions snippet to propagate run id into scanner and artifacts:

```yaml
env:
  SCAN_RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}-sast-${{ github.sha }}
steps:
  - name: run scan
    run: ./scan --run-id \"$SCAN_RUN_ID\"
```

infra-bot: automated: created issue SEC-64432-keystore-smoke and scheduled a nightly canary check.

owen: token-broker POC idea: issue a short-lived token TTL=180s after OPA evaluation allow_scan_token(principal, repo). require rate-limit and record approver metadata. broker should inject scan_run_id into KMS request context.

lia: critical: add audit label "scan_run_id" and "requester_principal" to all KMS RPCs so CloudAudit logs can be joined to pipeline traces. triage time drops when we can join by id.

maya: action items:
- maya: draft pre-rotation smoke script + update rotation runbook (ETA 24h)
- owen: build token-broker POC + open infra RFC (ETA 72h)
- lia: define placeholder-evidence schema + triage mapping (ETA EOD)

sec-oncall: noted. playbook update: any escrow/placeholder write must page sec-oncall + SRE; escrow retention 36h auto-delete; escrow writes create high-priority provisional ticket.

(emoji reactions: :white_check_mark: from owen, :eyes: from lia)
